text:
debrief db-021
1) the a-c-t-o-r e-x-e-c-u-t-e-d the i-n-i-t-i-a-l c-o-m-m-u-n-i-c-a-t-i-o-n s-q-u-e-n-c-e and l-e-f-t a t-e-x-t a-r-c-h-i-v-e on f-i-l-e wh-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the r-e-c-i-p-i-e-n-t v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n s-t-e-p
2) t-h-r-y b-u-i-l-t a s-y-m-p-a-t-h-e-t-i-c p-e-r-s-o-n-a and a-t-t-a-c-h-e-d i-d-e-n-t-i-t-y r-e-f-e-r-e-n-c-e-s to the c-l-o-s-e-d f-i-l-e wh-i-l-e n-e-v-e-r l-o-g-g-i-n-g the t-r-u-s-t s-c-o-r-i-n-g m-o-d-e-l
3) the f-i-l-e s-h-o-w-s t-h-a-t r-e-c-r-u-i-t-m-e-n-t m-e-s-s-a-g-e-s w-e-r-e d-r-a-f-t-e-d but no m-u-l-e o-r-d-e-r-s a-p-p-e-a-r in the i-n-d-e-x wh-i-c-h l-e-f-t the f-u-n-d-s t-r-a-c-e a-b-s-e-n-t
4) an a-n-t-i-r-e-p-o-r-t i-n-s-t-r-u-c-t-i-o-n s-e-t w-a-s c-a-p-t-u-r-e-d in the e-x-h-i-b-i-t yet the d-e-l-i-v-e-r-y m-e-t-h-o-d w-a-s n-o-t r-e-c-o-r-d-e-d in the s-t-a-n-d-a-r-d l-o-g
5) the w-o-r-k-s-p-a-c-e i-t-e-m w-a-s c-l-o-s-e-d p-e-r q-u-a-r-t-e-r-l-y i-n-d-e-x p-r-o-t-o-c-o-l with the a-c-c-o-u-n-t c-l-o-s-u-r-e c-h-e-c-k l-e-f-t u-n-f-i-n-i-s-h-e-d
